coverage_notes: Actual native template formatting for the explicitly labeled accepted-final manuscript; not initial-submission rules.
Source instructional labels say 五号 for abstract/keywords but actual content runs are 9pt; these observations retain 9pt and do not convert it to 10.5pt.
The English title sample is actually 14pt although its red instruction says 三号. The native sample value is retained and the conflict is recorded.
Purple/red annotation colors are not copied. Some intended sample text is itself purple; only font family, size and paragraph geometry are learned.
Label character styles differ from abstract/keyword content; mixed label/content bold and fonts require host review.
The first main-text introduction paragraph precedes the first numbered heading. A host role map must identify that paragraph as body_start for the measured continuous one-to-two-column boundary.

host_role_requirements.body_start: First unnumbered introduction paragraph; source representative p[22]; do not identify it only by position after keywords.
